description: This file is a JavaScript source file responsible for initializing and ensuring the readiness of a MySQL database schema for a notes application. It contains functions for validating environment variables, checking table existence, creating tables and columns if missing, and performing health checks on database connectivity.

methods.name: validateEnv()
methods.description: Validates presence of essential environment variables for MySQL connection and logs warnings if any keys are missing.

methods.name: tableExists(tableName)
methods.description: Checks if a specific table exists in the current database by querying INFORMATION_SCHEMA.

methods.name: ensureSchema()
methods.description: Creates necessary tables such as users, tags, users_auth, notes, and note_tags if they do not already exist. Also attempts to add missing columns to existing tables.

methods.name: ensureDatabaseReady()
methods.description: Performs overall readiness check by validating env variables, establishing a connection, and ensuring schema exists.

methods.name: checkConnection()
methods.description: Performs a health check to verify database connectivity and basic query execution.
